scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a cream dress and red robe gestures toward a sunlit stone house with seven pillars. A mallet and chisel rest beside her, with olive trees, flowers, and hills around the house.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Wisdom and the house with seven pillars she has hewn in Proverbs 9:1.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a sunlit stone courtyard pours red wine from a clay pitcher beside a set table bearing roasted meat, bread, fruit, and cups.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom preparing her meat and wine and setting her table in Proverbs 9:2.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a red and cream robe calls from a high stone terrace above a sunlit hill city, while several women carrying baskets walk down the steps toward its streets.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom sending her maidens and calling from the high places of the city in Proverbs 9:3.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures toward the open doorway of a warmly lit stone house as a young traveler with a staff turns to look at her on a sunlit town street.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Wisdom inviting the simple and those lacking understanding to turn in, as in Proverbs 9:4.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling woman holding a clay pitcher welcomes guests around a table of flatbread and cups of red wine in a sunlit courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom inviting people to eat her bread and drink the wine she has mixed in Proverbs 9:5.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four travelers in ancient clothing walk from a rocky, thorn-covered track onto a sunlit path through olive trees and wildflowers, with a hillside village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures leaving foolishness behind and walking in the way of understanding toward life, as expressed in Proverbs 9:6.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a troubled man in a blue shawl raises his hand toward a laughing man in a red robe, while several onlookers smile or laugh beneath trees and grapevines.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of correction met with mockery and embarrassment, reflecting Proverbs 9:7.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard beneath grapevines, an older man speaks with a raised finger and a hand on the shoulder of a smiling seated man, who holds one hand to his chest. Nearby, a third man stands with crossed arms and turns away with a scowl.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 9:8, contrasting a wise person who receives correction warmly with a scoffer who turns away.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunny stone courtyard, a gray-bearded teacher gestures as a seated man listens attentively, surrounded by trees, flowers and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a receptive learner receiving instruction, reflecting Proverbs 9:9 on the wise growing wiser and the just increasing in learning.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young traveler kneels with bowed head and open hands beside a stone path, among olive trees and wildflowers, as the sun rises over distant hills and a village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a reverent traveler at the beginning of a path evokes the fear of the Lord as the beginning of wisdom and knowledge of the Holy One as understanding.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures toward a sunlit valley as she walks beside a traveler under a large fruiting olive tree. A winding stone path leads past trees and water toward a distant village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene personifies Wisdom guiding a traveler along a flourishing path, evoking Proverbs 9:11 and its promise of multiplied days and added years of life.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man rests beneath a fruiting fig tree holding a fig, with a basket of figs beside him, while another man carries a large bundle of wood alone along a rocky path. A sunlit village and hills lie beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 9:12: wisdom benefits the wise person, while the one who scoffs bears the consequence alone.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a red dress calls out with one hand cupped around her mouth and the other extended in a sunlit stone village street, while nearby villagers turn toward her.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative personification of the clamorous woman of folly described in Proverbs 9:13.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a red robe sits on a carved wooden chair in the doorway of a stone house, overlooking a sunlit city of stone buildings, walls and towers below.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 9:14, showing the woman seated at her house entrance in the heights of the city.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman seated at a stone doorway reaches out toward two travelers walking along a sunlit road through a hillside town.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the call to passersby who continue straight on their way in Proverbs 9:15, with the caller drawn from the surrounding passage.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman seated in a stone doorway extends her hand toward a young man who has paused on a sunlit street and turned to look at her. Stone steps, plants, and a hillside town surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Folly calling the simple to turn in and speaking to someone who lacks understanding in Proverbs 9:16.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits in a shadowed stone alcove, glancing toward a sunlit passage as he holds a cup to his lips and a piece of bread in his other hand. A partly covered clay jar stands beside him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking Proverbs 9:17, which speaks of stolen water as sweet and bread eaten in secret as pleasant.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man approaches a warmly lit stone house where a woman beckons from the doorway; beneath the path, shadowed human figures sit in a deep underground cavern.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Proverbs 9:18: the visitor is unaware that the dead, her guests, are in the depths of Sheol.
